I'm a young worker drone who has no idea about how to get involved in politics besides voting (which, let's face it, is almost a waste of time). How would one go about running for local or state office?
How would one go about running for office?
Political activist > local representative > city Mayor > state Governor > Senator > Vice-president > President > ??? > PROFIT.

Assuming you are a US citizen... it varies... a lot!

For local positions, your city will have instructions. For State positions, your State will have instructions. For Federal positions, the federal government will have instructions, and usually you'll have to be familiar with instructions from every state you draw votes from.

There are a lot of rules, so its a good idea to volunteer for at least a year and try to learn the system from the inside.

If you are in a large metropolitan area, the deck is stacked against you, there are too many people who have made it there life's mission to get to office. It is still possible but there are a lot of people who have a large head start on you. If you are in a smaller community, your first move is to become a political activist, find an issue that is important to your fellow citizens and prove that you are willing to fight to support this issue. This will be the way to introduce yourself to the constituency and network with the local politicians. This is step one and would probably last three to five years

Now that you have shown your ability to work for the people , the next step is to run for something like school board or city councilman. In a lot of smaller communities these positions are achievable if you have a reputation for Working towards resolving local issues. This is the last step before fundraising and backroom dealing will have effect on your chances of being elected. Local office is probably where your journey will end if you believe in honesty and improving the lives of your fellow citizens. This is the place where you you have the chance to effect change and actually accomplish anything positive.

If you choose to continue, now you get to the next level, something like county commisioner, or state senator. This is the point where you really start making deals with unions, local businessmen, chamber of commerce and the like. At this level things start to get really dirty. It is hard to maintain your position or advance without fundraising, glad-handing, or spinning hot button issues over issues of substance. But the good news is this is where you can get kickbacks, bribes and other special benefits. If you can get through this without getting caught or without scandal, you are on your way to Washington.

Once you get to Washington, you basically have no power, until you get on a committee. To get on a committee you have to pay dues to your party and commit to fundraising for your party. Basically bribe your way onto a committee. Now you are starting to get some real power and benefits. Did you know it is completely legal for members to participate in insider trading. Now you are getting rich. Corporations and PACs will pay you exorbitant fees for speaking engagements and send you on exotic trips to study issues. Your fellow party members will cover up your affairs and hooker and coke habits. Get through this with out getting caught or without major scandals and you can start exploring a run for president. Start constructing your grandiose political promises and digging up dirt about your opponents.
